message.content:
This is an artificial Halloween tree, so it would normally go in heading 9505 (festive articles) or 6702 (artificial trees). Heading 6702 covers artificial flowers, foliage and fruit and parts thereof, and artificial Christmas trees are classified in 9505.10.25 (Christmas ornaments, other). CBP rulings generally put artificial Christmas trees in 9505.10.25, and I could not confirm the subheading from memory.

In the HTSUS, 9505.10 covers articles for Christmas festivities: 9505.10.10 is of glass, 9505.10.15 is nativity scenes, 9505.10.25 is other Christmas decorations, and 9505.10.35 and 9505.10.40 cover other items. A Halloween tree is not a Christmas article. It falls under 9505.90, "Other" festive, carnival or other entertainment articles. Subheading 9505.90.20 covers Halloween-type items and 9505.90.40 covers other, and 9505.90.60 is the other residual.

Halloween decorations went to 9505.90.60 ("Other") after the 2007 HTS restructuring. The subheading 9505.90.20 was formerly for "Confetti, paper spirals, ..." and I am not sure of its current wording. I will go with 9505.90.6000.
